verdict.rationale: A free entry point is suggested only by community reports that Granola is free for a limited number of notes. Docs name Business and Enterprise plans and gate some features to them, such as API keys, while HIPAA requires contacting sales for Enterprise. No published prices or full per-tier feature breakdown appear in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented tier prices, a complete first-party comparison of what each paid tier adds, first-party documentation of the free plan's limits, and evidence that basic paid tiers are self-serve without a sales contact.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start free and see exactly what each paid tier costs and adds — no "talk to sales" wall for basic use

citations.quote: Granola is only free for a limited number of notes.
Workspace admins on Business and Enterprise plans can also create workspace API keys.
Any workspace member on a **Business** or **Enterprise** plan can create API keys.
